observations.observation: Tom's Hardware reported the PC offer in an item published at 2026-09-29T11:10:00Z. This establishes what the article reported before cutoff, not the offer's start/end time or completed sales.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The item describes one consumer PC configuration and an advertised price; it does not identify a DRAM supplier, component shipment volume, or a Micron-specific sale. The publication timestamp is not evidence of the promotion's exact start or end.

observations.observation: The reported 32GB DDR5 specification does not identify the memory maker or connect the system to Micron. The inference is limited to the article's stated configuration; it does not establish a broader consumer-memory trend or change in Micron's company-level metrics.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: A single retail bundle is not supplier attribution, industry pricing evidence, or a measure of memory shipments, demand, or market share.

gaps: No contemporaneous archived retailer listing or checkout capture was verified, so the advertised price and availability are supported here by the editorial report rather than an independently captured transaction page.
The PC offer does not name the DRAM manufacturer, memory-module part, or Micron as a supplier.
